data.name: Boxing Day (Gloves Optional)
data.headline: Boxing Day. No gloves, just a 12-class pack at 20% off.
data.benefit: Boxing Day, gloves optional: 12-class packs are 20% off on 26–27 Dec only. Stock up before the January rush. Two per person.
data.rationale: The week after Christmas is empty in studio but busy on phones. A two-day pack price pulls January purchases forward without touching membership prices.
data.audience: Everyone: pack buyers, members topping up, newcomers.
data.conditions: Spot offer, 20% cash. Two per person. 26–27 Dec only.
data.kpi: Packs sold in 48 hours; January visits on Boxing Day packs.

scenes.title: Resolution Insurance (Claim Approved)
scenes.narration: New clients: Resolution Insurance (Claim Approved). Insure your resolution before you make it. 13 buyers at 17,203 rupees — 2.24 lakh rupees. 15 per cent off.

data.name: Resolution Insurance (Claim Approved)
data.headline: Insure your resolution before you make it. Claim approved.
data.benefit: Insure your resolution before you make it: buy your first month now, start any day 1–10 January, and January’s late-cancel fees are on us. Plus a freeze for when life happens. Claim approved.
data.rationale: Most January resolutions fail in week two. Cover for the usual excuses (late cancels, a bad week) costs little and is exactly what a nervous December buyer needs to hear.
data.audience: First-time clients (phone verified); members buying for a January start.
data.conditions: Standard 15% only. Start date 1–10 Jan 2028. Cover applies to January only.
data.kpi: Pre-sold January starts; January attendance of insured buyers.

scenes.title: The Gift They Won’t Regift
scenes.narration: New clients: The Gift They Won’t Regift. The gift they won’t regift. 29 buyers at 2,499 rupees — 72,471 rupees. 20 per cent off.

data.name: The Gift They Won’t Regift
data.headline: The one gift that doesn’t end up in next year’s Secret Santa.
data.benefit: The gift they won’t regift: 2 classes, grip socks and ₹1,000 off their first membership, in a box that looks expensive. Buying for the office? 10+ boxes get 10% off and a team class.
data.rationale: A gift arrives with a friend’s endorsement, which is why gifted and referred clients convert far better than ad leads. The credit only pays out when the recipient buys.
data.audience: Members and non-members buying for someone new; offices.
data.conditions: Credited intro product (acquisition cost). On conversion: 1 Month at 15% less the credit ≈ 20% effective. Recipient must be new to P57.
data.kpi: Boxes sold; boxes redeemed by 31 Jan; recipient → member (target 30%).

data.name: The Ex-Files: Season Finale
data.headline: Every great series needs a finale. Yours is a comeback.
data.benefit: The Ex-Files: Season Finale. Before 2027 ends, one last episode: come back for 10% off (15% on 3 months) and bring a plus-one to our NYE Countdown Class.
data.rationale: People who come back in December arrive in January already in the habit. The plus-one turns a returner into a referral at the busiest social week of the year.
data.conditions: Lapsed 90+ days. 1M 19.6% / 3M 18.4% effective with the guest pass at list.
data.kpi: Reactivations; plus-ones who buy in January.

data.name: The Advent-ure Calendar (Opens in January)
data.headline: An advent calendar you open in January, when you actually need it.
data.benefit: An advent calendar you open in January, when you need it most: renew for 3, 6 or 12 months in December and get 12 doors of perks, one a week from 3 Jan. Guest passes, a private, smoothies and a golden door.
data.rationale: January drop-off is when renewals are lost. Spreading the perks across Jan–Mar gives members a reason to show up every week of the hardest quarter, which is what keeps them renewing.
data.conditions: 3M 18.9% / 6M 18.5% / annual 21.8% effective (calendar at list). Doors expire 31 Mar 2028; one calendar per renewal.
data.kpi: December renewal yield; Q1 2028 visits of calendar holders vs others.
